company.name: Alector, Inc.
company.business: Alector is a biotechnology company developing therapies intended to counteract neurodegeneration, including programs using its blood-brain barrier delivery platform.

why.headline: Alector disclosed a September 30, 2026 license agreement with Genentech covering certain GCase candidates. Genentech will lead development, regulatory, manufacturing and commercialization across indications, while Alector retains its Alector Brain Carrier platform and rights for its wholly owned pipeline. Alector said the partnership extends its cash runway into 2029. The agreement was publicly disclosed October 5.
